The actual Gradle wrapper JAR is located at:
content-rating-display-213568/vod_content_rating_frontend/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Tools expecting a wrapper at the repository root should delegate to:
./gradlew :appRoot:assembleDebug
or
cd content-rating-display-213568/vod_content_rating_frontend && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
